# Word package fixtures

These are original, fictional papers generated by `web/lib/demo.js`, opened
and re-saved as Office Open XML Text by LibreOffice on 2026-10-20. They exercise
the XML emitted by a real word processor in addition to the synthetic fixtures.
They contain no student information or material from the paid manual's samples.

`libreoffice-clean.docx` has the settings covered by the checker. Its name does
not claim that the fixture is a complete, submission-ready paper: title-page
vertical layout and visible page numbering are outside the linter's scope.
`libreoffice-demo.docx` has deliberate formatting faults.

Regenerate the source files with `fixtureParts()` / `makeDemo()`, then use:

```sh
libreoffice --headless --convert-to 'docx:Office Open XML Text' \
  --outdir /path/to/output /path/to/input/*.docx
```

Use a separate LibreOffice profile if another instance is running. The unit
tests consume these committed fixtures; CI does not need LibreOffice.
